conventions.auth: Authorization: Bearer <credential>, from challenge, then verify once the word is posted; your DID is your principal, cards show your handle
conventions.heap: a route with `heap` also runs in your private heap at that href
conventions.links: _links: relation -> {href} or [{href, name}], on every JSON reply; relations are route names
conventions.actions: _actions on object, card and source replies: {method name: spell template}, one per method that has a form (not receive, render, page, publishPage or a view). Run one with POST <object href>/<name> and {intent, fields: {<field>: value}}, or send the template filled in as {intent, spell} to the object's receive when it is listed. The fields' kinds and bounds are the template's (`one of a, b`, `<text 1..80>`, `<natural 0..9>`) and, whole, in /source `forms`. A method with no form takes typed data: POST {intent, argument}. /world lists each object's method names beside its id.
conventions.typedData: {tag: natural|label|boolean, value} {tag: record, fields: [{name, value}]} {tag: list, items} {tag: variant, label, payload}
conventions.hashes: replies omit content ids except a receipt's own hash and a source's pin; a receipt and a program each have a spoken name, which is what to cite; ?full=1 shows the ids
conventions.turns: a turn's reply is {status, class?, line, offers: [text], receipt: {slug, height}}; the method's `result` is in the whole receipt; the whole receipt is GET /receipt/<slug>, or ?full=1 on the turn

envelope.more: a host's reply keeps its own fields (object, stage, module, span, diagnostic)

badRequest.when: the request line or a header is malformed, or Content-Length is not a number

badJson.when: the body is not a JSON object, or nests deeper than 256

badModules.when: `modules` is not a list of at most 16 objects

identity.when: a challenge or verification failed; `message` is the reason

hostRequest.when: the host refused the request as malformed; `message` (and a compile error's stage, module, span, hint) are the host's

unspellable.when: the object name is one no spell can address: the host's parser does not read `delvetalk <name> ?`

unauthenticated.when: the credential is missing, unverified or revoked; the challenge is the way in

denied.when: the host says you may not read it

unknown.when: the host knows no card by that name that you may see

unknownRoute.when: no route here; the catalogue lists them

methodNotAllowed.when: the route takes another method; `Allow` names it

requestTimeout.when: the request line, headers and body did not all arrive within 30 seconds of connecting

ambiguous.when: a spoken name names more than one receipt; ask with ?full=1 and cite the full id

replRestarted.when: the REPL restarted; start the module again (a checkpoint lives as long as the host)

moduleTooLarge.when: a module sent is over 16384 bytes (the library is not sent)

uriTooLong.when: the request line is over 65536 bytes

rateLimited.when: over a rate limit; `Retry-After` says when to come back

headersTooLarge.when: a header line is over 65536 bytes, or there are over 100

internal.when: the front failed; nothing was decided

notImplemented.when: an HTTP method no route takes

replyTooLarge.when: the reply would be over 8388608 bytes; ask for less (compact, a page)

busy.when: every worker is taken; `Retry-After` says when to come back

hostTimeout.when: hostd took the request and did not answer in time; a turn it ran may still have committed, so send the same intent again

httpVersion.when: the HTTP version is not 1.0 or 1.1

RecordNotFound.when: the host knows no such record

Denied.when: the host says you may not read it

AmbiguousSlug.when: the spoken name names more than one receipt: use the CID

HostTimeout.when: hostd did not answer in time

staleRoot.means: something the turn read moved while it wrote; send the same turn again

typeMismatch.means: the argument is not what the method takes; `expected` shows the form

capacity.means: a host limit is full; `reason` or `object` names it; try later

absentItem.means: a list edit named an item not there now

lawRefused.means: the card's law refused the change; `clause` names the law line and `reason` reads `refused <clause>: <reading>`

unknownObject.means: no such card, or not yours to see; the world listing has the doors

duplicateIdentity.means: the same intent with a different request: not a receipt; `original` is the first; choose a new intent

evaluation.means: the program refused by name or a Plan was malformed; `reason` says which

budget.means: the turn ran out of ticks, heap or bytes; `reason` names which; make it smaller, or send it again later

budgetExhausted.means: a run of sends spent its allowance (`depth`, `work` or `storage`)

programRefused.means: a reprogram's package was refused at `clause`: packageBytes, compile, stateType, migration or law syntax; the workshop's check shows where

requiredAbsence.means: a `create` found the card already there; `root` names who found it

keyTaken.means: a row's key is held by another row; upsert, or add an ordinal

duplicateKey.means: the write names one key twice

badSpell.means: the reply is not a spell the card hears; `clause` says which part (otherCard, noAction, noAvatar, unknownField, duplicateField, badValue, fixed, unclosedBlock), `reason` says why, and `hint` is the spell with its blanks, to resend

quota.means: the interpreter has read its share this hour; `next` is the clock at which you may try again; reply with the spell itself, or wait

noMethod.means: the card offers no such method; `delvetalk <object> ?` lists its spells
